# Vendored third-party files

Served as plain ES modules / fonts; no build step. Update by re-downloading the same URLs.

| File | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anime.esm.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/animejs@4/+esm | 4.5.0 | MIT |
| `../fonts/archivo-*.woff2` | Google Fonts, Archivo variable (wdth 62–125, wght 100–900), latin + latin-ext subsets | v25 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
